mandatory_defect_classes.name: CUSTODY_CANARIES_SYNTHETIC
mandatory_defect_classes.statement: The claimed 45-per-implementation custody canaries assign expected outcomes without applying isolated mutations and invoking the actual validator.

mandatory_defect_classes.name: RAW_BATCH_VALIDATION_SYNTHETIC_ONLY
mandatory_defect_classes.statement: Raw-batch validators have no real file/CLI path and do not enforce the complete active review schema against an actual persisted batch.

mandatory_defect_classes.name: CONSENSUS_ROLE_SPOOFABLE
mandatory_defect_classes.statement: Consensus role identity can be supplied by reviewer-controlled content instead of a trusted outer dispatch slot.

mandatory_defect_classes.name: ACTIVE_B_SPEC_STILL_NINE
mandatory_defect_classes.statement: The active B specification still normatively requires the original nine-item audit contract instead of the exact thirteen-item successor contract.

mandatory_defect_classes.name: DECISION_SET_INSIDE_CORE_CYCLE
mandatory_defect_classes.statement: The supersession decision set is inside CONTENT_SET and therefore transitively inside the ratified SUBJECT.

mandatory_defect_classes.name: HISTORICAL_19_BYTES_MUTATED
mandatory_defect_classes.statement: Historical correction 19 is 4925/a1743625... instead of the fixed 4583/e62873c3... identity; added metadata belongs in a detached wrapper.

mandatory_defect_classes.name: VALIDATION_TRANSCRIPTS_STALE_OR_WEAK
mandatory_defect_classes.statement: Validation transcripts omit the exact subject, command, cwd, runtime identity and timestamps needed to prevent reuse against another core.

mandatory_defect_classes.name: PROVENANCE_NOT_FULLY_RECOMPUTED
mandatory_defect_classes.statement: The checker does not prove decoded span equality to claim, recompute each source_item_sha256 and recompute the ordered thirteen-item aggregate.

required_recovery_sequence: build a new core without ratification bytes, decision-set or owner anchor
create a detached trusted ratification index
create a detached owner anchor and activation request only after that index
